decisions.statement: A batch written is named in the list the caller handed in before the next runs.
The checkpoint left outside the checkout is named as soon as it is written.
Samples are written in batches so a run that stops has still landed the batches that came before.
A run carries on from its checkpoint rather than from the start.
A run states the count the run wrote for each metric rather than one total.

definition: one import run, from the records read to the samples written
